common_prompt.en: Assume your basic living needs are covered, and judge whether each choice below describes you. There are no right answers.
common_prompt.zh: 假设基本生活已有保障，判断下面的选择是否符合你。没有正确答案。

rules.0.en: No total health score is calculated, and no disease probability, pain weight, treatment effect, willingness to pay or refusal of treatment is inferred
rules.0.zh: 不计算总健康分，不推断患病概率、疼痛权重、疗效、愿付金额或拒绝治疗

rules.1.en: Health answers take none of the six areas' 100 points and are not a seventh scoring weight; they only inform the clones' planning and do not change illness rules, γ, H, accounts or satisfaction
rules.1.zh: 健康回答不占六维 100 分，也不是第七个评分权重；只供分身做计划，不改变疾病规则、γ、H、账目或满足感

rules.2.en: The questions are provisional wording, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale
rules.2.zh: 题目是暂定文案，没有经过认知访谈或量表验证

unanswered_rule.en: An unanswered question is stored as “not answered”, separately from “not sure yet”; both mean there is no explicit instruction for that item, and no middle value is filled in
unanswered_rule.zh: 没有作答另存为“未答”，与“暂不确定”分开；两者都表示没有这一项的明确指令，不补中间值

leisure_states.0.en: Not answered: no explicit information on this item, evaluated with neutral rules; it is never treated as choosing the “generic evaluation”
leisure_states.0.zh: 未答：没有这一项的明确信息，按中性规则评价；不会被当成“通用评价”的选择

leisure_states.1.en: Not sure yet: evaluated with neutral rules
leisure_states.1.zh: 暂不确定：按中性规则评价

leisure_states.2.en: Explicitly no fixed hobby: evaluated with neutral rules
leisure_states.2.zh: 明确没有固定爱好：按中性规则评价

leisure_states.3.en: Use the generic leisure evaluation: try whatever suitable the city offers (evaluated with neutral rules)
leisure_states.3.zh: 采用通用休闲评价：城市有什么合适的就体验什么（按中性规则评价）

leisure_states.4.en: Describe in words: candidates are first formed from the vocabulary, and only the categories you choose enter the evaluation; unrecognized descriptions are kept as written and not evaluated in this version
leisure_states.4.zh: 用文字描述：先按词表形成候选，你选中的类别才进入评价；没认出的描述原样保留，本版不评价

matching_note.en: A confirmed interest only brings moderately higher satisfaction for the same actual time spent (model assumption: 50% more, with a cap); a confirmed cuisine only makes meals to your taste that you actually eat count a little more. These coefficients are publicly registered model assumptions, not measurements of you; they do not change your points, cash or qualifications, and do not make expensive things automatically better
matching_note.zh: 确认的兴趣只在同样的实际参与时间下带来适度更高的满足（模型假设：多 50%，有上限）；确认的菜系只让实际吃到的合口味餐多计一点。 这些系数是公开登记的模型假设，不是对你个人的测量；不改变你的点数、现金或资格，也不让贵的东西自动更好

taste_states.0.en: Not answered: evaluated with neutral rules

taste_states.1.en: Not sure yet: evaluated with neutral rules
taste_states.1.zh: 暂不确定：按中性规则评价

taste_states.2.en: Explicitly no taste preference: evaluated with neutral rules
taste_states.2.zh: 明确没有口味偏好：按中性规则评价

taste_states.3.en: Describe in words: candidates are first formed from the vocabulary, and only the cuisines you choose enter the food evaluation; brands and other requirements are only kept
taste_states.3.zh: 用文字描述：先按词表形成候选，你选中的菜系才进入饮食评价；品牌与其他要求只留存

item.0.en: City data come from public sources and registered model settings; life rules, scoring and evaluation parameters are synthetic exploratory settings: the results do not rank real cities and are not real-world recommendations
item.0.zh: 城市资料来自公开来源与登记的模型设定；生活规则、评分与评价参数是合成探索设定：结果不排序真实城市，也不是现实推荐

item.1.en: The safety background is converted from each metro area's 2024 crime statistics (a statistical proxy, not a person's probability of experiencing crime; for New York it covers only the New York State part of the metro area); the leisure background is a setting shared by the six cities; treatment prices are a shared assumption; eating-out, services, device lifetimes and activity prices include registered model settings
item.1.zh: 安全背景按各都会区 2024 年犯罪统计换算（统计代理，不是个人遭遇犯罪的概率；纽约只覆盖都会区的纽约州部分）；休闲背景是六城共同设定；治疗价格是共同假设；外食、服务、设备寿命与活动价格含登记的模型设定

item.2.en: The offline planner is a controllable mock and does not represent a real large language model's ability or understanding of preferences
item.2.zh: 离线规划器是可控的 mock，不代表真实大语言模型的能力或偏好理解

item.3.en: The questionnaire wording and reference improvement ranges are provisional drafts, not tested in cognitive interviews or validated as a scale
item.3.zh: 问卷文案与参考改善范围是暂定稿，没有做认知访谈与量表验证

canonical_form.en: A whole number after reducing (30) or numerator/denominator (50/3); calculations and comparisons use it, display rounds to 1 decimal place, and displayed values never feed back into calculations
canonical_form.zh: 约分后的整数（30）或 分子/分母（50/3）；计算与比较都用它，显示四舍五入到 1 位小数，显示值不回流计算

manual_entry.en: Manual entries are parsed as exact decimals with at most 2 decimal places (the step is not a measurement precision); fractions in lowest terms are also accepted (for example 50/3)
manual_entry.zh: 手工输入按精确十进制解析，最多 2 位小数（步长不是测量精度）；也接受规范分数写法（例如 50/3）

rules.0.en: The six areas must add up to exactly 100; no values are pre-filled, no personality presets are offered, and other items are never reduced proportionally
rules.0.zh: 六维合计必须精确等于 100；不预填数值、不提供人格套餐，不自动按比例扣减其他项

rules.1.en: An equal split is generated only when the user chooses “split equally” (50/3 for each of the six areas, 25 for each material item), so items listed first get no extra points
rules.1.zh: 只有用户主动选择“平均分配”才生成均分（六维每项 50/3、物质每项 25），不让排在前面的项目多拿分

rules.2.en: An explicit 0 is a provided value; “not answered”, “explicitly no strong view” and “not sure yet” are never turned into 0 or an equal share automatically
rules.2.zh: 明确 0 是已提供的数值；“未答”“明确无所谓”“暂不确定”都不会被自动换成 0 或均分

rules.3.en: When material life is positive, the four material items must also add up to exactly 100; when material life is explicitly 0, the breakdown does not apply and no four answers are invented
rules.3.zh: 物质父项为正时，物质四项也必须精确合计 100；物质父项明确为 0 时细分不适用，不伪造四个回答

rules.4.en: Since material life went from three items to four and the meaning of food widened, old confirmations cannot be carried over by adding a 0 or redistributing points: please review and confirm again
rules.4.zh: 物质从三项改成四项、饮食的含义扩大之后，旧的确认不能补 0 或重新分配点数沿用：请重新审阅并确认

item.0.en: This is a simplified scenario of moving to a candidate city and starting over: it starts in year 1, healthy, with no belongings, no courses in progress and no savings goal
item.0.zh: 这是一次搬到候选城市重新开始的简化情景：从第 1 年、健康、没有已有物品、没有在学课程、没有资金目标开始

item.1.en: Real old furniture, medical history and ongoing courses are not included yet; this is an assumption of the simulation, not a judgement about your real situation
item.1.zh: 现实中的旧家具、病史与在学课程暂未纳入；这是模拟的假设，不是对你现实情况的判断

item.2.en: The same you has the same age, cash, abilities and base time and energy in every city and every clone; specific jobs in a city are matched against the local catalogue
item.2.zh: 同一个你在各城市、各个分身里的年龄、现金、能力与基础时间精力都相同；城市里的具体岗位按当地目录匹配

item.0.en: Multi-person households, non-wage income (interest, dividends, side jobs), shared household assets, buying a home and loans
item.0.zh: 多人家庭、非工资收入（利息、股息、副业）、家庭共同资产、买房与贷款

item.1.en: Tax credits, pre-tax deductions and itemized deductions; residents of the New York metro area outside New York City, the Indiana part of the Chicago metro area, and cross-state combinations
item.1.zh: 税收抵免、税前扣除与逐项扣除；纽约市以外的纽约都会区居民、芝加哥都会区的印第安纳部分、跨州组合

item.2.en: Parking fees and distance-based transit fares; San Francisco transit fares (the official website refused access)
item.2.zh: 停车费与按距离计的公交票价；旧金山的公交票价（官方网站拒绝访问）

item.3.en: Real Chicago Park District activities (they need date windows, whole-session registration and age eligibility, which the engine does not support yet)
item.3.zh: 芝加哥公园管理局的真实活动（需要日期窗口、整期报名与年龄资格，引擎暂不支持）

item.4.en: Scoring of brands, preparation, tier, service quality and home-visit concerns (the text is only recorded)
item.4.zh: 品牌、制作方式、档次、服务质量与上门顾虑的评分（只记录原文）

item.5.en: Interview-style input (only the interfaces for sources and evidence references are kept)
item.5.zh: 访谈式输入（只保留来源与证据引用接口）

label.en: Ease of commuting

support_note.en: This version has only the city's background conditions; clones cannot improve it by acting
support_note.zh: 本版只有城市背景条件，分身不能行动改善它

definition.en: What you actually get from consumption: the condition of your home, whether food is fresh and to your taste, whether phone, internet and household supplies are convenient, whether daily chores are easy, and clothing and personal care (split into four items inside)

label.en: Material life
label.zh: 物质生活

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: from a one-bedroom far away, eating mostly rice, flour and canned food and doing all the laundry and cleaning yourself, to three fresh-ingredient meals a day and about 18 fewer hours of housework a month (one step of improvement in this version's synthetic model)
reference_improvement.zh: 参考情境：从远处一居室、以米面罐头为主、洗衣打扫全部自己做，改善到每天三顿新鲜食材、每月少做约 18 小时家务（本版合成模型里的一档改善）

support_note.en: Housing condition, food, daily support and convenience, and personal consumption and enjoyment are all scored on actual life; other material needs such as storage are not in this version
support_note.zh: 居住条件、饮食生活、日常支持与便利、个人消费与享受四项都按实际生活评分；储物等其他物质需求本版没有

definition.en: The career and growth conditions the city offers, plus new abilities you actually learn in your life

reference_improvement.en: Reference situation: finishing a 12-month qualification course within a year, or the city's opportunity conditions rising from a synthetic index of 4 to 8

agree_meaning.en: Willing to accept a higher chance of getting sick and needing rest for a little more income
agree_meaning.zh: 愿意为多一点收入接受更高的生病与休息可能

disagree_meaning.en: Not willing to accept a higher chance of getting sick and needing rest for a little more income
disagree_meaning.zh: 不愿意为多一点收入接受更高的生病与休息可能

text.en: One arrangement earns a little more money, but also makes it more likely that you get sick and need a few days of rest. I am willing to choose it.
text.zh: 一种安排能多赚一点钱，但生病、需要休息几天的可能也更高。我愿意选择它。

agree_meaning.en: Willing to postpone non-urgent purchases and set money aside for possible health costs first
agree_meaning.zh: 愿意推迟不急需的消费，先为可能的健康开支留钱

disagree_meaning.en: Not inclined to postpone non-urgent purchases for possible health costs
disagree_meaning.zh: 不倾向为可能的健康开支推迟不急需的消费

text.en: To be ready for possible health costs, I am willing to postpone a purchase I want but do not urgently need, and set some money aside first.
text.zh: 为了应对可能发生的健康开支，我愿意推迟一次想要、但并不急需的消费，先留一笔钱。

agree_meaning.en: When health-risk information is unclear, willing to give up a small immediate gain and wait until things are clear
agree_meaning.zh: 健康风险信息不清楚时，愿意先放弃一点眼前收益、等了解清楚

disagree_meaning.en: When health-risk information is unclear, not inclined to give up an immediate gain in order to wait
disagree_meaning.zh: 健康风险信息不清楚时，不倾向为了等待而放弃眼前收益

text.en: When information about a health risk is still unclear, I am willing to give up a small immediate gain and decide once things are clear.
text.zh: 健康风险的信息还不清楚时，我愿意先放弃眼前的一点收益，等了解清楚再决定。

label.en: Laundry: without a device or service, washing by hand or at a self-service laundromat, including drying, folding and putting away

definition.en: Whether phone and internet service and household supplies are easy to get, and whether daily chores are easy.
definition.zh: 通信联网、家用日耗品是否方便获得，以及日常杂务是否省心。

label.en: Daily support and convenience
label.zh: 日常支持与便利

note.en: Chores count by how many hours you actually do less yourself (devices and human services are two ways to get there and are not scored separately); phone, home internet and household supplies count by the months actually bought, and buying two of the same item counts no more; it is relative importance, not a budget or an order to buy; it covers phone service and household supplies beyond the old “daily convenience”, so old confirmations need a new review
note.zh: 杂务看本人实际少做了多少小时（设备与人工服务是两种实现方式，不分别打分）；通信、居家联网与家用日耗品看实际买到的月份，同一项买两份不多算；它是相对重要程度，不是预算或必须购买的指令；含义比旧版“日常生活便利”多了通信与日耗品，旧的确认要重新审阅

definition.en: Whether the complete food plan you actually eat (cooking at home or eating out) is fresh and matches the taste you confirmed
definition.zh: 实际吃的完整食品方案（自己做、外食都可以）新鲜不新鲜、合不合你确认的口味

label.en: Food
label.zh: 饮食生活

note.en: Only fresh meals and the cuisines you confirmed are evaluated; having enough to eat is a basic guarantee and earns nothing extra; price, restaurant tier and how often you eat out do not mean better; preparation time counts in the time budget
note.zh: 只评价新鲜餐与你确认的菜系；吃饱是基本保障，不另加分；价格、餐馆档次与外食次数不等于更好；准备时间算在时间账里

definition.en: The condition of the home you actually live in: whether there is enough space, and how good it is among homes of its kind
definition.zh: 实际住的那一处房子本身的条件：空间够不够用、同类房子里条件好不好

label.en: Housing condition
label.zh: 居住条件

note.en: Only the home itself counts; rent, commuting and the area's safety and environment are not in this item (safety and environment are counted separately by the area you live in); the old “living space (floor area only)” meant something different, so old confirmations need a new review
note.zh: 只看房子本身；房租、通勤、地区的安全与环境不在这一项（安全、环境按住处所在片区另算）；旧版的“居住空间（只看面积）”含义不同，旧的确认要重新审阅

definition.en: Beyond other living costs, the satisfaction of personal consumption such as clothing and personal care.
definition.zh: 在其他生活开支之外，获得衣着、个人护理等个人消费的满足。

label.en: Personal consumption and enjoyment
label.zh: 个人消费与享受

note.en: Evaluated by the standard personal consumption basket (clothing, shoes and accessories, personal care) you actually get each month, not by how much you spend; the same basket costing more does not change this item, only buying less lowers it; it is an explainable model abstraction and does not measure a real person's happiness; massages and home comfort goods are no longer counted separately; the meaning differs from the old version, so old confirmations need a new review
note.zh: 按每月实际获得的标准个人消费篮子（衣着、鞋履与配饰、个人护理）评价，不按花了多少钱；同样的篮子涨价不改变这一项，买得少才会少；是可解释的模型抽象，没有测量真实人的幸福感；不再单独计算按摩或居家舒适用品；含义与旧版不同，旧的确认要重新审阅

notes.en: Anchor coordinates are INTPTLAT / INTPTLONG (decimal degrees) from the Census 2024 Gazetteer CBSA file. The Gazetteer record layout does not restate a datum; the same internal points appear in the official 2024 TIGER/Line CBSA file (7 decimals, equal to the Gazetteer values when rounded to 6), whose coordinate system is NAD83 (.prj GCS_North_American_1983, also stated in section 3.3.3 of the TIGER/Line technical documentation), so the original datum is NAD83. They are published as WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) through EPSG transformation 1188, "NAD83 to WGS 84 (1)": all three translations are zero and its accuracy is about 4 m, so the numbers are unchanged. An error of that size does not matter for a metro-area representative point.
notes.zh: 锚点坐标取自 Census 2024 Gazetteer CBSA 文件的 INTPTLAT / INTPTLONG（十进制度）。Gazetteer 的记录格式没有另写基准；同一批内部点在官方 TIGER/Line 2024 CBSA 文件里也有（七位小数，四舍五入到六位与 Gazetteer 相同），那份文件的坐标系是 NAD83（.prj 为 GCS_North_American_1983，技术文档 3.3.3 节也这样写），所以原始基准是 NAD83。发布为 WGS 84（EPSG:4326）时用 EPSG 登记的 1188 号转换“NAD83 to WGS 84 (1)”：三个平移量都是 0，精度约 4 米，所以数值原样不变；这样的误差对都会区代表点没有影响。

notes.en: City geography follows the CBSA 2023 delineation (OMB, July 2023, Bulletin No. 23-01). All 935 CBSAs in the 2024 Gazetteer CBSA file have the same codes and titles as the July 2023 delineation file used by the pack.
notes.zh: 城市地理按 CBSA 2023（OMB 2023 年 7 月划定，Bulletin No. 23-01）。2024 Gazetteer CBSA 文件的 935 个 CBSA 与资料包所用的 2023 年 7 月划定文件编号、名称逐条一致。

notes.en: The anchor is the internal point (a representative point) that Census computes for the whole metro area. It is not a home, the principal city's centre or a boundary, and in a large metro area it can be far from the main city. This version has no home, street or PUMA polygons.
notes.zh: 锚点是 Census 为整个都会区计算的内部点（代表点），不是住处、主城市中心或都会区边界；都会区范围大，点可能离主城市市区较远。首版不提供住宅、街道或 PUMA 多边形。

notes.en: This list does not grant run eligibility: the capabilities list and service rules decide which cities can be chosen, and a city without an anchor can still be opened from the city list.
notes.zh: 这份清单不授予运行资格：能选哪些城市由能力清单与服务规则决定；没有锚点的城市仍可从城市列表访问。

2024 Gazetteer Files record layouts: INTPTLAT / INTPTLONG are the latitude and longitude of the internal point in decimal degrees (no datum restated)
2024 TIGER/Line Shapefiles: Core Based Statistical Areas (tl_2024_us_cbsa.zip); INTPTLAT / INTPTLON of the six CBSAs equal the Gazetteer values (rounded to 6 decimals); .prj GCS_North_American_1983
2024 TIGER/Line Shapefiles Technical Documentation, chapter 3, section 3.3.3 Datum: all Census Bureau generated TIGER/Line Shapefiles are in GCS NAD83
List 1: Core Based Statistical Areas, Metropolitan Divisions and Combined Statistical Areas, July 2023 (list1_2023.xlsx; based on OMB Bulletin No. 23-01)
Transformation 1188, NAD83 to WGS 84 (1): NAD83 (EPSG:4269) to WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), geocentric translations 0, 0, 0 m, accuracy 4 m, extent North America - Canada and USA (CONUS, Alaska mainland)

catalog.inventory.not_exhaustive.en: This only says whether the candidates surveyed within the declared scope have complete data; it does not claim to cover the whole city market, and having no record does not mean the city has none. Supply status (offered / definitely not offered / unknown), data status and compile status are recorded separately: definitely not offered is a settled survey result, but not a purchasable option. This is a different judgment from whether actual trajectories can be scored or a clone's C / E / M: catalog gaps do not rewrite the scoring of trajectories that already happened
catalog.inventory.not_exhaustive.zh: 这只说明声明范围内调查过的候选资料齐不齐，不保证穷尽整个城市市场；没有记录不等于城市没有。供给状态（有卖 / 确定没有 / 不知道）、资料状态与编译状态分开记：确定没有是已确定的调查结果，但不是可购买的方案。它与实际轨迹能否评分、分身的 C / E / M 是不同的判断：目录缺口不改写已发生轨迹的评分

catalog.inventory.not_offered.en: Confirmed that this city does not offer this option: the survey result is settled, but it is not a purchasable option
